$schema_note: Maps docs/ACTION_VOCABULARY.md action ids to animation clips. status: 'covered' = licence-clean clip is in anim/ now; 'owner' = free clip that needs the owner's login (BOOTH or Mixamo); 'procedural' = stays computed at runtime (no clip wanted or none suits). Clip refs: quaternius:<clipName> in quaternius/…/AnimationLibrary_Godot_Standard.glb (CC0), vrma:<file> in anim/vrma/, mixamo:<file> in anim/mixamo/ (see OWNER_CARD_mixamo.md). 'primary' is what the runtime should play first; 'alternates' are fallbacks or mood variants; 'procedural_layer' is what stays procedural on top even when a clip plays (per ACTION_VOCABULARY realisation column).

vrma.status: 1 fixture downloaded; VRoid 7-pack is an owner step

mixamo.licence: Adobe Mixamo (free, no redistribution of raw files)

idle.notes: Idle_Loop is a 2.5 s standing loop with weight shift; owner alternates add mood variety.

walk.notes: 1.333 s loop, front-facing walk toward the viewer verified in preview/shots/quaternius_Walk_Loop_*.png. Hips translation is kept (root motion stays on `root`, which is unmapped, so the clip is effectively in place). Lateral walk waits on the side-view model per ACTION_VOCABULARY §5.

run.notes: Not in the action vocabulary yet; listed because the task asked for run coverage.

procedural_layer: vertical offset from the main process window motion
hop.notes: A hop is Jump_Start (1.33 s) cut at take-off, then Jump_Land (1.27 s) from touchdown; the airborne part is the window moving. Jump_Loop is the airborne hold if a longer flight is needed.

procedural_layer: hips pinned to the edge height from world sense
sit.notes: Enter/Idle/Exit set covers the full transition. Chair height is baked into the clip's hips translation; the runtime should override hips y with the sensed edge.

alternates: quaternius:Death01 (hold last frame; lies on back, see preview/shots/quaternius_Death01_1.png)
sleep.notes: Quaternius has no sleep clip; Death01's end pose is a usable lying pose as a stopgap but the fall itself is too violent for a sleep enter. Mixamo 'Sleeping Idle' + 'Lying Down' are the requested pair.

wake.notes: ≤1.5 s per vocabulary; trim get_up.fbx or time-scale it.

stretch.notes: Quaternius Standard has no stretch. Until the Mixamo file lands, procedural (arms-up spline on both arms + spine extension).

procedural_layer: hands and feet IK-pinned to the sensed vertical edge
climb.notes: Proposed action. Clip supplies the limb rhythm; IK does the contact. Also waits on the side/3-4 view.

procedural_layer: physics impulse from window motion drives everything
stumble.notes: Vocabulary says P → P. Hit_Chest/Hit_Head are good 0.3–0.4 s flinch overlays to blend at impact; Roll for a hard drop.

recover.notes: ≤1.2 s; Jump_Land's second half is a usable recover already (covered as a stopgap).

procedural_layer: two-bone IK on the nearer arm to the target point
reach.notes: Primitive stays procedural per vocabulary; Interact is a reference for arm timing.

wave.notes: VRoid 'Greeting' (VRMA_02) is a native .vrma, plays with zero retargeting once the owner downloads the 7-pack (SOURCES.md). No wave in Quaternius Standard; procedural arm wave until then.

eat.notes: Hero action #2 in authoring order; Mixamo 'Eating' is the requested base.

celebrate.notes: Dance_Loop is a 1 s loop; play 2–3 cycles.

tail_react.notes: No humanoid clip has a tail; VRM spring bones handle it.

extra_coverage_requested_by_task.push: quaternius:Push_Loop (covered, unused; could serve 'reach' against a window edge)
